name: Do volatile spells with new money go up

sections.hypothesis: In the HMM's volatile spells, weeks that start while stablecoin supply has grown over 4 weeks are followed by better BTC and ETH returns than volatile weeks that start while it has shrunk.
sections.rationale: Luke's theory (2026-11-15): the regime model says when a big move is likely (volatile spells persist) but not which way; stablecoin growth tilted weeks upward in its own study (+0.78% vs -0.38%, P 91%). If new money decides the direction of a volatile spell, a long-only account could be in for the big up-moves and out for the big down-moves, the half of the MACD finding it couldn't use (MACD's direction in volatile spells continued, mostly downward). A raw-effect study first, one look, before any strategy. Honest limits: about 75 volatile weeks over BTC and ETH, so each side has few samples; and both inputs are things Kestrel has already studied, so a positive result needs the strategy test and forward data before anyone believes it.
sections.rules: kestrel volatile-study BTCUSDT ETHUSDT --signal stablecoins --research <this note>. Daily bars; the regime model's filtered volatile state (stored fits, monthly refits) and stablecoins_up (supply known at the close, from two days after each day, above its value 28 days before). Samples: days in a volatile spell, at least a week apart, with the next 7 days' log return; split by stablecoins_up. The same is reported for other days. Pooled over both coins, before the holdout, run once.
sections.falsification: The volatile study's rule, fixed before the run: TREND (growth leads to better volatile weeks) if P(spread > 0) is at least 90% and the spread beats one round trip of costs; REBOUND if the opposite with the same confidence; otherwise KILL. Only TREND leads to a strategy note.
sections.parameters: None to choose: 7 days, 28 days and the regime model's preset are fixed.
sections.costs: A study: one look, recorded with its verdict. Hurdle: one round trip at kestrel.toml's costs (about 17 bps).

history.reason: KILL (Luke, 2026-11-15): in volatile spells the weeks after supply growth averaged -0.75% vs +0.71% after shrinkage (53 and 22 weeks, P 21%). Stablecoin growth doesn't say which way a volatile spell goes.
